Problem:
• Message interception
• Slow communication
• No real-time synchronization
Solution:
• Real-time encrypted messaging
• Hybrid Socket.IO + WebRTC communication
• End-to-End Encryption

Problem:
• Centralized servers expose transit routes
• Server stores messages in database, creating a single point of failure (SPOF)
• Server exposes metadata logs
Solution:
• Establish direct, serverless browser-to-browser WebRTC Data Channels
• Use a lightweight WebSocket signaling server as an ICE/SDP broker
• Bypassing database logs for direct communication
API Requirements: Signaling Server: ws://localhost:3001; Events: join, leave, signal

Problem:
• Direct transfer of large files in browser environments causes JS heap memory exhaustion
• Browser tab crashes during large file transfers
Solution:
• Slice files into 32KB chunks
• Compute SHA-256 integrity hash per chunk
• Stream via WebRTC data channel with sliding-window ACK flow control
• Reassemble as Blob in memory
Tech Stack: Web Crypto API (SHA-256), Javascript ArrayBuffers, WebRTC Data Channels
API Requirements: Data Channel Events: file_metadata, file_chunk, file_ack

Problem:
• Database stored messages are vulnerable to database leaks
• Administrator/third-party snooping of plaintext data
Solution:
• Apply AES-256-GCM encryption
• P2P payloads encrypted using scrypt-derived channel keys
• Database messages encrypted at Hono API level prior to database write
Tech Stack: Web Crypto API, NodeJS crypto library, AES-256-GCM, PBKDF2, SSL/TLS
API Requirements: Cipher envelope: nonce, ciphertext, version payload

Problem:
• Unauthorized modification of past message logs inside SQL database tables cannot be detected
• Lack of tamper-proof message verification
Solution:
• Implement a local Proof-of-Work blockchain hash ledger
• Send events to mempool and mine blocks (PoW difficulty: 4 leading zeros)
• Validation checks fail if any message is altered
Tech Stack: Hono Node.js API, TypeScript, SHA-256 block hashing

Problem:
• Traffic analysis firewalls monitor and flag encrypted communication protocols
• Deep packet inspection identifying messaging traffic as suspicious
Solution:
• Obfuscate messages by encoding them in media files
• Use LSB red channel for PNGs, binary appends for MP3/MP4/WebM files, and post-%%EOF characters in PDFs
Tech Stack: Jimp (Image LSB), NodeJS Buffers, AES-256-GCM (scrypt derived keys)

Problem:
• Retaining communication history indefinitely increases risk of forensic recovery
• Server-side storage bloat and metadata analysis risks
Solution:
• Enforce strict 24-hour Time-to-Live (TTL) on all messages
• Sweep database records on boot, nightly at midnight via cron, or on-demand from the admin panel
Tech Stack: PostgreSQL tables, Prisma client hooks, node-cron

Problem:
• Rogue nodes can join rooms and spoof sender identities
• Sybil flooding attacks in decentralised channels
Solution:
• Generate ECDSA did:key pairs locally and store private keys in sandboxed IndexedDB
• Sign all WebRTC packets; peers verify signatures and blacklist nodes on 3+ check failures
Tech Stack: Web Crypto API (ECDSA P-256), IndexedDB (nexus-identity), React State
